image_description: A high-angle shot of a public toilet with a white ceramic bowl and black seat. The toilet seat is covered in layers of white toilet paper, arranged to create a sanitary barrier. Additional loose sheets of toilet paper are scattered on the grey tiled floor around the base of the toilet. A chrome flush pipe extends from the top of the cistern. The background features white subway tiles.
